hero.prompt:
Animate the supplied exact illustration as a polished, fluid hand-drawn 2D skateboard push cycle. This is a coordinated FULL-BODY character action, not a still torso with a dangling leg. Preserve Zoomer's original white elongated face, orange hair, oval glasses, gray tee, charcoal baggy trousers, backpack, camouflage high-top sneakers, upright matcha drink and crisp black comic outlines. Remain flat 2D cel animation, never 3D.

The skateboard stays framed in the lower right and Zoomer faces right. With every push the SUPPORTING FRONT KNEE visibly bends and extends, the hips lower and rise, the torso leans forward then recovers, shoulders counterbalance, the head makes a small natural counter-bob and the backpack follows through. Make these joint changes clearly visible but restrained, like a relaxed human skating. The supporting front shoe (right side of picture) remains planted on the deck throughout; the knee and thigh above that shoe MUST articulate, not lock. The deck stays beneath the supporting shoe.

The REAR LEG (left side of picture) swings forward beside the board, lowers its sole onto the concrete beside the rear truck at the wheel contact level, pushes backward against the ground, then lifts behind the body and returns through the air. One coherent shoe and leg, real heel/sole contact, relaxed knee bend and continuous weight transfer. Roughly five connected push-and-recover actions over six seconds. Do not walk, run, jump, swap feet or step onto the wheels. The free arm gently balances; the drink hand follows the torso through a bending elbow while keeping the cup upright and the same grip.

Motion is ongoing from the first frame through the last; match the opening pose again at the end of a complete cycle for a forward-only seamless loop. No idle hold at either end, no freeze, no ping-pong or reversed action, no dissolves, ghost trails, doubled limbs, rubber shoes or changing camouflage. Keep the entire head, body, both shoes and skateboard visible with the original open left sky for separate HTML typography. Fixed camera relative to the board, no zoom or cut. For clean character compositing the illustrated park/sky/concrete background is absolutely static in this source pass; the whole character and both articulated legs animate against it. Do not bake any text or logos into the picture.
